"GAME PROMPT: EARTH CORE MINER

Create a 3D realistic first-person mining simulator where the player starts on Earth and must dig a gigantic hole all the way down to the Earth's core.

1. Game Environment

- The game takes place on Earth.
- The player starts at an outdoor mining facility.
- A massive mining rig is positioned in the center of the mining site.
- A science laboratory is located beside the mining rig.
- An oil shop is located beside the science laboratory.
- All three buildings and structures must be accessible to the player.

2. Mining Rig

The mining rig is the main machine used to dig underground.

Features:

- A giant vertical drilling machine.
- The drill continuously digs deeper into the Earth.
- Realistic drilling animations and rock-breaking effects.
- The rig requires oil to operate.
- Show the current drilling depth.
- Show the machine's oil level.

Oil Refilling System:

- The player must purchase oil from the oil shop.
- Oil is delivered as containers or barrels.
- The player carries the oil to the mining rig.
- Walk to the TOP of the mining rig.
- Find the oil refill opening.
- Press E to interact and pour the oil into the machine.
- Show an oil-pouring animation.
- The oil gauge increases after refilling.
- The mining rig cannot operate when it runs out of oil.

3. Science Laboratory

Located beside the mining site.

Players can enter the laboratory to upgrade their mining equipment.

Available upgrades:

- Drill Power – Break harder underground materials.
- Drill Speed – Dig faster.
- Oil Capacity – Hold more oil.
- Oil Efficiency – Consume less oil.
- Heat Resistance – Handle extreme underground temperatures.
- Drill Durability – Improve machine reliability.

Display upgrade prices and the player's available money.

4. Oil Shop

Located directly beside the science laboratory.

Features:

- Buy oil containers.
- Buy larger oil tanks.
- Display oil prices.
- Show available oil inventory.
- Interact with a purchase counter.
- Carry purchased oil manually to the mining rig.

5. Underground Layers

As the mining rig digs deeper, it discovers different geological layers.

1. Surface Soil
2. Dirt and Clay
3. Limestone
4. Stone
5. Coal Deposits
6. Iron Deposits
7. Gold Deposits
8. Diamond Deposits
9. Deep Mantle
10. Magma Zone
11. Earth's Outer Core
12. Earth's Inner Core

Each layer should have unique textures, colors, resources, and environmental effects.

6. First-Person Controls

- WASD – Move
- Mouse – Look around
- E – Interact
- Left Click – Use equipment
- Shift – Sprint
- Space – Jump

7. User Interface

Keep the interface clean and simple.

Display:

- Current depth (meters).
- Player money.
- Mining rig oil level.
- Drill status.
- Current underground layer.
- Mining progress.

8. Visual Style

- Realistic 3D environment.
- First-person camera.
- Open-world outdoor mining facility.
- Detailed mining machinery.
- Realistic oil containers and pouring animations.
- Atmospheric underground lighting.
- Smooth animations and environmental effects.

9. Main Objective

The player's ultimate goal is to reach the Earth's core.

They must manage oil, upgrade their mining rig, purchase supplies, discover underground resources, and continuously improve their equipment to dig deeper.

Make the experience immersive, satisfying, and progressively challenging.10. Mobile Joystick Controls

Add mobile touchscreen controls with a clean, modern layout.

- Left Joystick: Move the player forward, backward, left, and right.
- Right Screen Area: Swipe to rotate the first-person camera.
- Jump Button: Jump over obstacles.
- Sprint Button: Run faster.
- Interact Button (E): Purchase oil, refill the mining rig, and use laboratory upgrade stations.
- Action Button: Operate mining equipment.

Mobile UI

- Place the movement joystick at the bottom-left corner.
- Place action buttons at the bottom-right corner.
- Make all buttons responsive and comfortable to use.
- Keep the screen uncluttered.
- Support both landscape orientation and different mobile screen sizes.

The joystick must work smoothly with the first-person camera and all player interactions.Add this section to the game prompt:

## 10. Mobile Joystick Controls

Add mobile touchscreen controls with a clean, modern layout.

- **Left Joystick:** Move the player forward, backward, left, and right.
- **Right Screen Area:** Swipe to rotate the first-person camera.
- **Jump Button:** Jump over obstacles.
- **Sprint Button:** Run faster.
- **Interact Button (E):** Purchase oil, refill the mining rig, and use laboratory upgrade stations.
- **Action Button:** Operate mining equipment.

### Mobile UI
- Place the movement joystick at the bottom-left corner.
- Place action buttons at the bottom-right corner.
- Make all buttons responsive and comfortable to use.
- Keep the screen uncluttered.
- Support both landscape orientation and different mobile screen sizes.

The joystick must work smoothly with the first-person camera and all player interactions.

This makes the game fully playable on mobile. 🎮

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D first-person Earth-core mining simulator with a responsive mobile joystick and touchscreen controls.

## Requirements
- Outdoor mining site with accessible drill rig, science lab, and oil shop.
- Oil purchase, manual carrying/refilling at the rig’s top hatch, drilling and oil gauges, six lab upgrades, geology layers, resources, money, and progress UI.
- WASD/mouse/E/click/Shift/Space controls plus mobile movement joystick, swipe-look, jump, sprint, interact, and action buttons.
- Make reasonable assumptions; do not ask clarifying questions. Check screenshots and save a small JPEG.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-file Three.js browser game in `index.html`, using CDN imports and procedural geometry.
- Initial funds set to $480; oil cans cost $80 and hold 60 L.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a single-page visual shell with responsive HUD, modal styles, and mobile control layouts in `index.html`.
- Added procedural outdoor scenery, rig, lab, shop, and supply/upgrade station geometry.
- Added partial game-state, modal, interaction, keyboard, mouse, and touch-control JavaScript.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript module: player movement/collision, camera updates, drill progression/oil consumption, geological transitions/rewards/effects, animation loop, resize handling, and initial UI update.
- Verify that the HTML/module parses and the game is playable; address interaction and accessibility issues.
- Capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- The game is not yet runnable as a complete experience: the `<script type="module">` currently has no closing `</script></body></html>` or completed render/update loop, and major gameplay systems remain unfinished.
- No screenshot or browser verification has been performed.

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `index.html` from the last appended JavaScript handler code; finish game logic and close the HTML document.
2. Run the project and resolve syntax/runtime errors.
3. Test desktop and mobile controls and progression; fix any issues.
4. Save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot, then summarize assumptions and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all current game markup, styles, Three.js scene construction, and incomplete game script.

## Important Context
- The current `index.html` contains the scene-building code and handlers, but does not yet include a game animation loop or a complete document ending.
- Changes are uncommitted.
